description: Add a fail-closed bookkeeping-only PR CI gate in scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py and wire .github/actions/bookkeeping-gate into expensive CI workflows so pure plans/, executions/, and holon-knowledge/ bookkeeping pushes skip redundant test and build runs.
goal: Add stdlib-only scripts/ci_bookkeeping_api.py and scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py (each well under 200 lines) implementing a fail-closed bookkeeping-only pull-request push gate: return skip=true only on pull_request synchronize/labeled/unlabeled first-attempt runs when every changed path between before and after (both names of a rename) is a .md, .json, or .jsonl file under plans/, executions/, or holon-knowledge/ (or a non-result-affecting label change, never skipping for module-budget-change or ci-timing-override labels), the new head is strictly ahead of before, and the same CI job previously succeeded cleanly on the chain ancestor; fail closed to skip=false on any API error, non-bookkeeping change, diverged/force-push, or missing prior success.

Add composite action .github/actions/bookkeeping-gate/action.yml invoking python3 scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py with zero YAML comments, and wire it into .github/workflows/test-unit.yml, .github/workflows/test-integration.yml, .github/workflows/test-hygiene.yml, .github/workflows/make.yml, and .github/workflows/docker-build.yml so expensive setup/test/build steps skip when steps.bookkeeping_gate.outputs.skip == 'true'.

Add unit and workflow-wiring tests in tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py verifying bookkeeping-only skips, non-bookkeeping full runs, force-push/API-error fail-closed behavior, chain traversal across skipped runs, and wiring across all 5 workflow files.

Write zero docstrings and zero comments in every new or edited Python and YAML file so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Over half of CI check-runs on pull requests currently re-run full unit, integration, hygiene, make, and docker-build jobs on pure chore(review) and chore(calibration) bookkeeping commits; gating those pushes fail-closed eliminates wasted CI minutes without weakening code checks.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/ci_bookkeeping_api.py and scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py implement a stdlib-only fail-closed bookkeeping gate (skip=true only for verified bookkeeping-only .md/.json/.jsonl changes under plans/, executions/, or holon-knowledge/ with prior green job chain, or non-result-affecting labels; skip=false on any error, force-push, or non-bookkeeping path).

.github/actions/bookkeeping-gate/action.yml wraps scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py and is wired into .github/workflows/test-unit.yml, .github/workflows/test-integration.yml, .github/workflows/test-hygiene.yml, .github/workflows/make.yml, and .github/workflows/docker-build.yml with zero YAML comments.

tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py verifies gate decisions, fail-closed errors, chain walking, and workflow wiring for all 5 workflows, and uv run pytest plus uv run task lint pass with zero docstrings or comments and without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.

assumptions.statement: GitHub Actions workflows and composite action .github/actions/bookkeeping-gate/action.yml run with python3 stdlib only (urllib, json, os, sys) and GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_EVENT_PATH available on pull_request events.

All 5 gated workflows (test-unit.yml, test-integration.yml, test-hygiene.yml, make.yml, docker-build.yml) can skip expensive setup/test/build steps via steps.bookkeeping_gate.outputs.skip == 'true' while keeping scripts/ci_bookkeeping_api.py and scripts/ci_bookkeeping_gate.py under 200 lines and module_budgets.json untouched.

assumption_validation.method: Verify stdlib-only gate and GitHub API event/compare/check-run chain handling in tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py.
Verify workflow YAML wiring for all 5 workflows in tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_gate.py, plus uv run pytest, uv run task lint, and check_module_budgets.py.

assumption_risk.response: fail closed to skip=false on any API error, missing token, or unexpected payload
verify every workflow YAML and module line budget in unit tests and hygiene lint
